description: Runs GigHQ's CareerCompass AI pipeline against the user's resume data to generate 3 candidate professional objective statements, a positioning statement, categorized skills, and a suggested target market (industries, company sizes, geographic locations). This is an EXPENSIVE, one-time 'career strategy' action (4 parallel AI completions server-side) — not a cheap or repeatable lookup. Prefer get_career_compass first to check for existing saved data. Nothing is persisted by this call; use save_career_compass afterward, and only with the user's explicit review and authorization.

career_stage.description: The user's career stage, if known. Omit if not established in the conversation.

career_switch_details.description: Required for useful output when career_stage is 'Career Switcher'.

switch_type.description: How the user is switching careers, e.g. 'industry change' or 'role change'.

target_industry.description: Industry the user wants to move into.

target_role.description: Role the user wants to move into.

name: generate_career_compass
